## Purpose
The `tool_safety_rules` table.

## Responsibilities
`SafetyRule` has these columns:
- `id` (e.g. "no_arbitrary_code"), `title`;
- `rule`, the text the model reads;
- `enabled` (default False), `strictness` (advise, standard or strict; default standard);
- `applies_to` (a JSON list of point keys), `builtin`, `sort` (default 100);
- the timestamps.
